silent_failure_surface.details: Resource provider bare-path equality, Juce ES-module namespace, 17/17 param-ID coverage, DPR canvases, BinaryData symbols, boot call graph all verified clean. No blank-page or dead-control risk.

theme_fidelity.details: Garamond, aged-paper palette, 10-segment seed-knob conic-gradient, green toggles, fleurons, wide-tracked labels all on-brand. CSS vars match aesthetic.md char-for-char. Botanical overlay opacity 0.16 is under the ~0.35 spec.

pedagogy.details: All 17 params + routing have tooltips; 5 presets write plausible normalised values via correct scaledToNorm (no centre-skew present); routing diagram reflects ratio/index/feedback state. One tooltip text contradicts the diagram (MOD vs CAR feedback).

experience_design.details: Live viz, reactive routing, presets, tooltips present. Dead dblclick no-op and pointer-only tooltips (no keyboard/touch) are minor UX gaps.

issues.description: Botanical overlay opacity is 0.16, roughly half the aesthetic contract of ~0.35 (0.3-0.4). The signature insect illustration is nearly invisible, weakening the one-illustration-per-plugin brand pillar.
issues.fixSuggestion: Raise overlay opacity to ~0.22-0.25; overlay sits at z-index 0 behind controls (z-index 1) so it will not crowd readouts. Re-check visually that it does not compete with the right-side knob column.

issues.description: TIPS.routing tooltip says "CAR's self-loop is Feedback" but the SVG diagram, updateRouting (drives opMod brightness), and the DSP all put feedback on MOD (modulator self-feedback). In a pedagogy plugin the explanation contradicts the diagram.
issues.fixSuggestion: Change the routing tooltip text to "MOD's self-loop is Feedback" so the copy matches the diagram and the DSP.

issues.description: Tooltips are pointer-only (pointerenter/move/leave/down). No focus/blur handlers and controls are not focusable (EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE). The role=tooltip / aria-hidden markup implies accessibility intent not delivered; the field-guide layer is mouse-only.
issues.fixSuggestion: Acceptable for a plugin, but either drop the unused ARIA attributes or add title/aria-label fallbacks on controls if accessibility is desired. Track as a verify-phase note, not a blocker.

issues.description: dblclick knob handler is a registered no-op. Users habitually double-click a knob to reset to default; here it silently does nothing while ns-resize cursor sets a drag expectation.
issues.fixSuggestion: Remove the inert listener (JUCE WebSliderState exposes no default-query, so reset is not trivially supported) or implement reset via a per-id default map. Removing is the honest minimal choice.

issues.description: Fleuron ornament uses U+2766 (the floral heart) at title and toggle corners. Some Windows WebView2 font fallback chains (Garamond/Times) may lack the glyph and render tofu (missing-glyph box) on a cross-platform target.
issues.fixSuggestion: Verify rendering on Windows WebView2; if it tofus, switch to a more widely supported ornament (U+2726 or U+2767) or ship as an inline SVG/icon.

issues.description: Static value cell for modFixedHz shows bare "220" without a unit, unlike every other cell which carries units in static HTML (e.g. "10 ms", "0%"). FORMAT.modFixedHz renders "220 Hz". Confirmed: APVTS default IS 220 Hz (PluginProcessor.cpp:65), so only the missing unit is wrong for ~1 frame before first repaint.
issues.fixSuggestion: Change index.html:81 static text to "220 Hz" so the pre-bind frame matches the formatter.

issues.description: Spectrum bar hue mapping (hue = 90 - norm*40, HSL 90->50) reaches a saturated chartreuse at high intensity that is brighter/more modern than the muted earth palette. Cosmetic, data-display only.
issues.fixSuggestion: Optionally bias the high-intensity hue toward --green-mid/sage for on-brand cohesion; not required.

issues.description: Wheel handler brackets every notch in its own sliderDragStarted/Ended pair; rapid scroll spams host automation-write/undo entries.
issues.fixSuggestion: Acceptable common pattern; optionally debounce the drag-end after wheel activity stops. Note-level.
